s0.title: Move with the arrows. OK picks. Back goes back.
s0.line2: That's 90% of everything — you can't break anything.

s1.title: This is your Home screen.
s1.line2: Big cards: Live TV, Plex, Support and the Store.

s2.title: The bar up top is yours.
s2.line2: What you were watching, your live channels with what's on now, and picks based on what you watch. OK jumps straight in.

s3.title: The scrolling line at the very top is news from us.
s3.line2: Deals, updates and heads-ups show there.

s4.title: My Account and Settings live in the top-right corner.

s0.title: Open Live TV from the Home screen.
s0.line2: Sign in with the details your seller gave you. Every account you add shows in one list.

s1.title: Pick your look: Classic, Compact or Vibez.
s1.line2: Live TV asks the first time. Change it any time under Player Settings → Appearance.

s2.title: Pick a category, then a channel.
s2.line2: In Compact, the categories are one press to the LEFT. Back from the channels goes to the categories.

s3.title: Rest on a channel and it plays in the preview box. OK goes full screen.
s3.line2: In Vibez, OK plays right away. While watching, OK shows the controls; Up and Down change the channel.

s4.title: The Guide shows what's on now and what's next.

s5.title: Multi-Screen plays 2 or 4 channels at once.
s5.line2: The sound follows the tile you highlight.

s6.title: Channel not working? Hold OK on it.
s6.line2: Report a problem, add it to Favorites, or refresh a favorite whose link changed. Reports come straight to us.

s0.title: Open Plex from the Home screen.

s1.title: Signed into Live TV? Plex connects by itself — no code to send.
s1.line2: Not signed in yet? Press Connect with Live TV. You don't need your own Plex account.

s2.title: The menu down the left: Home, Discover, your libraries, Search, Request.
s2.line2: OK on a poster opens the title page — then press Play.

s3.title: Not sure what to watch? Discover has Hidden Gems, Surprise Me, genres and decades.
s3.line2: Home shows what you were watching, new arrivals and Most Watched.

s4.title: Don't want a library? Hold OK on it in the menu to hide it.
s4.line2: Bring it back under Settings → Hidden.

s5.title: Need subtitles? Open the Subtitles menu and pick 'Get subtitles…'.

s6.title: No sound? Open the Audio menu and press 'Fix audio'.
s6.line2: It fixes the sound without restarting your movie.

s0.title: Main Apps has every extra app you might need — all in one safe place.
s0.line2: Find it in Support → Main Apps.

s1.title: Press OK on an app, then Download to install it.
s1.line2: Already installed? It just says Launch.

s0.title: Stuck? Support has your back.
s0.line2: Three tabs: Help, AI Chat and Posts.

s1.title: Speed Test checks if your internet is fast enough for streaming.

s2.title: TV keeps pausing? Open the Buffering Guide — it walks you through easy fixes.

s3.title: Submit a Ticket to reach a real person.
s3.line2: A count shows on the Support card when we answer.

s4.title: Box running slow or out of space? Device Cleaner frees it up.
s4.line2: It empties every app's cache, closes background apps, and lists apps nobody opens.

s5.title: AI Chat answers instantly — and can do things for you.
s5.line2: Ask it to open a screen, change your Live TV look, report a channel, install an app, or make you a wallpaper.

s6.title: Posts: every email we send lands here too.
s6.line2: Dated, marked New until you open it, readable full screen. Links become a code you scan with your phone.

s0.title: My Account is your Dashboard — everything on one screen.
s0.line2: Your streaming account, devices and services, and your Snow Gems. Prefer it bigger? Settings → UI → Large dashboard.

s1.title: Snow Gems power Premium AI and Image Gen.
s1.line2: Purchase Snow Gems: pick a pack, scan the code with your phone, pay there — the gems land on your account by themselves.

s2.title: The Game Lounge: Blackjack, Roulette, Slots, Plinko, Dice, Video Poker, Trivia and the Daily Spin.
s2.line2: Play for Snow Coins and climb the leaderboard. Never real money.

s0.title: Change your wallpaper under Settings → Media Manager.
s0.line2: Upload your own, or describe one and let AI make it.

s1.title: Settings → UI has the switches.
s1.line2: Content bar on or off, Large dashboard, Post notifications, and alerts on this device.

s2.title: Saved Accounts remembers your sign-ins so you never retype them.

howTo.title: How to use SMC
howTo.pickTopic: Pick a topic — press Back anytime to leave.

hints.intro: Pick the app that is buffering, then press Next.
hints.step1: Only one channel or title? Report it and we fix it at the source.
hints.step2: Force Stop, then Clear Cache, then press Back to come here.
hints.step3: Aim for 15 Mbps or more on this device.
hints.step4: Install, sign in, Quick Connect, then test again.
hints.summary: Send these results to support if it is still buffering.

kidsHints.step1: Only one channel or title? Tell a grown-up which one.
kidsHints.step2: Ask a grown-up to clear the app's cache.
kidsHints.step4: Ask a grown-up to set up a VPN.
kidsHints.summary: Still buffering? Show this to a grown-up.

buffering.title: Fix Buffering
buffering.skipToVpnTitle: Already tried a VPN? Jump straight to the VPN step.
buffering.skipToVpnBtn: Already tried the rest? Go to the VPN step

kidsOne.title: Tell a grown-up
kidsOne.lead: When only one channel or show fails, it gets fixed at the source. Tell a grown-up which one — they can report it from their profile.

toast.openedSettingsDesc: Tap Force Stop, then Storage → Clear Cache. Press Back when done.
toast.webOnlyDesc: This action only works inside the installed Snow Media Center app.
toast.enterTitleDesc: Type the channel or movie/show name first.
toast.pickDeviceDesc: Tell us which device you are watching on.
toast.reportSentDesc: Thanks! Sign in next time to track it on your account.
toast.openAndroidSettingsDesc: Find the app, then tap Force Stop and Clear Cache.
toast.speedLowDesc: Below 15 Mbps will cause buffering. Try 5GHz Wi-Fi, move closer, or use Ethernet.
toast.switchVpnServerDesc: Pick the closest city/server, then re-test for 15+ Mbps.
toast.getSpeedFirstDesc: Switch VPN city/server, then re-test speed.
toast.awesomeDesc: Likely ISP throttling — keep VPN on while streaming.
toast.enterSpeedDesc: Type the Mbps you saw above, then continue.

anon.title: Send report without signing in?
anon.body1: Your report will be submitted to Snow Media support, but it will <0>not</0> be saved to your account.
anon.body2: Tip: Go back to the Home Screen and tap <0>Sign In</0> first so your ticket is saved on your account and you can track replies.

signInPrompt.title: Sign in to submit a ticket
signInPrompt.body1: You need an account to submit a support ticket so our team can <0>reply back to you</0> and you can track the conversation.
signInPrompt.body2: Sign in or create a free account to submit your ticket and get replies back.

vpnSkip.title: Skip the VPN step?
vpnSkip.body1: Heads up: Your internet provider can slow you down during peak hours — or for no clear reason at all. In 2026, ISP throttling is the <0>#1 cause of buffering</0>.
vpnSkip.body2: If nothing has worked up to this point, installing and turning on a VPN will more than likely fix it. You can still continue if you'd rather skip for now.

intro.title: Which app is buffering?
intro.lead: We'll go through the usual fixes one at a time. This is for Snow Media's streaming apps — Netflix, Disney+ or Hulu buffering is usually something else.

report.title: Report the channel or title
report.lead: Tell us exactly what's buffering in <0>{{appLabel}}</0> and what you watch on. We'll open a support ticket so it gets fixed at the source.
report.namePlaceholder: e.g. ESPN HD, The Bear S03E01
report.deviceQuestion: Which device are you watching on?

step1.title: Is it one channel, or everything?
step1.lead: When only one channel or title fails, your internet is usually fine — it's the source, and we can fix that on our end.
step1.oneSub: Report it and we'll fix it

step2.title: Refresh {{app}}
step2.lead: Clearing the app's cache fixes a lot of buffering. It doesn't sign you out or delete anything.
step2.kidsNote: Ask a grown-up to do this part. In the box's settings for {{app}}: <0>Force Stop</0>, then <1>Storage → Clear Cache</1>.
step2.item2: Go to <0>Storage → Clear Cache</0> (not Clear Data)
step2.item3: Press <0>Back</0> on your remote to come here
step2.notInstalled: {{app}} doesn't look installed on this device. Install it from Main Apps first.
step2.question: Did that fix the buffering?
step2.stillSub: Next we'll test your internet speed

step3.title: Test your internet speed
step3.lead: Streaming needs at least 15 Mbps download on this device. Run the test here, or type in a result from another speed test.
step3.tooSlow: Too slow for smooth streaming. Try 5 GHz Wi-Fi, move the box closer to the router, or use an Ethernet cable, then test again.
step3.emptyHint: Run the test and your result shows here.

step4.title: Try a VPN
step4.lead: Internet providers often slow streaming down, especially in the evening. A VPN hides your streaming from them, and is the most common fix.
step4.kidsNote: A VPN is a grown-up's job. Ask one to set it up and turn it on, then come back and try your stream again.
step4.runVpnBtn: Run speed test with VPN on
step4.speedLowSub: Pick a closer VPN city, then test again

vpn.item1: <0>Sign in</0> — your reseller has the details, or sign up with the QR code
vpn.item2: Choose <0>Quick Connect</0>, then come back and try your stream
vpn.paidNote: A VPN is a paid service — free ones are too slow for streaming. It does <0>not</0> work with VibezTV.
vpn.scanToSignUp: Scan with your phone to sign up

summary.kidsNote: Still buffering? Show this screen to a grown-up. They can send it to support from their profile.

oneOnly.title: It's that one channel or title
oneOnly.b1: If only one channel/title is failing, your internet is usually fine.
oneOnly.b2: Email the exact channel/title name to support so we can fix it fast.

cacheFixed.title: Fixed: clearing the cache did it
cacheFixed.b1: Clearing cache + restarting refreshes the app and connection.
cacheFixed.b2: If it happens again, repeat the Force Stop + Clear Cache step first.

slow.title: Your internet is too slow on this device
slow.b1: Speed on the streaming device is under 15 Mbps ({{speed}} Mbps).
slow.b2: Switch to 5GHz Wi-Fi, move closer, or try Ethernet.

vpnFixed.title: Fixed: your provider was slowing you down
vpnFixed.b1: VPN working means your ISP likely slowed streaming traffic (especially during peak hours).
vpnFixed.b2: Keep VPN on while streaming and use a nearby/fast server.
vpnFixed.b3: If speed drops with VPN, choose the closest VPN city/server and re-test (15+ Mbps).

still.title: Still buffering: let's get support on it
still.b1: Re-check speed test closer to the router (15+ Mbps).
still.b2: Try VPN with a different nearby city/server and re-test speed (15+ Mbps).
still.b3: Press Send to support and we will pick it up from your results.
